domain: crowd crush at a mass gathering

Enclosed stadium bowl.provides: known capacity, ticketed entry, defined exit routes

Open field festival.provides: no fixed capacity, many informal routes, weather exposure

Street procession.provides: no entry control at all, unbounded numbers, buildings constraining the width

Transport interchange.requires: a station concourse serving the event
Transport interchange.provides: surge arrivals and departures, fixed narrow passages

Progressive crowd collapse.requires: density above about six people per square metre
Progressive crowd collapse.provides: people unable to control their own movement, asphyxia without any panic

Counterflow at a bottleneck.requires: two streams meeting in a constricted space
Counterflow at a bottleneck.provides: sustained pressure at one point, no escape valve

Sudden surge toward an attraction.provides: rapid density rise in one area, short duration

Evacuation rush from a threat.requires: a perceived danger behind the crowd
Evacuation rush from a threat.provides: unidirectional flight, disregard of designated routes

Timed entry ticketing.provides: arrival rate limited, no effect once people are inside

Physical barriers and pens.provides: subdivision of the crowd, new bottlenecks if misplaced

Real-time density monitoring.requires: cameras or sensors and someone watching
Real-time density monitoring.provides: warning of dangerous density, no physical effect by itself

Stewarding and messaging.requires: trained staff and a public address system
Stewarding and messaging.provides: influence on behaviour, defeated by noise and by a crowd already immobile

Mass fatality crush.provides: multiple deaths, criminal and public inquiry exposure

Event abandoned safely.requires: a decision taken before the crowd becomes critical
